name: Live FEMA and ESA public raster source/layer loading plus dependent FEMA composition/removal boundary

scenarios.prompt: Show standalone FEMA NFHL flood zones for New Orleans, Louisiana.
Show standalone ESA WorldCover for Rome, Italy.

fixes: FEMA upstream routed through FEMA's official ArcGIS Online relay with required Origin/Referer headers (data/catalog/overlays/fema_nfhl_flood_zones.json, app/server/services/geospatial/api_service.py)
Scale-dependent raster overlays zoom to their declared min_zoom (app/client/src/app/components/map-preview.component.ts)
remaining_limitation: FEMA NFHL layer 28 is scale-dependent (needs zoom >= 14); composing it with a partner layer at a single viewport is constrained because tested partners (ESA WMS, USGS gauges, GIBS, Census) do not render or overlap at that zoom. The overlay composition/removal mechanism is validated via T3-06 and FEMA's standalone render.
